The total is the sum of the transfer to the Treasury for budgetary support (90% of NTF, recorded as cbi_transfers_to_government), debt reduction, NTF operating expenses and the contingency fund allocation (10% of NTF). This sheet prints no currency (amounts bare or with '$'); recorded as EC$ like the other rows from it, because the same Ministry template states 'Figures are quoted in Eastern Caribbean Dollars' (Oct-Dec 2022 sheet) and the amounts match EC$ conversions of the US$ prices (e.g. NTF US$200,000 x 2.7 = EC$540,000 per approval).
